---
title: "Home runs"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| label: hr-by-season
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(home_runs_per_game = total_HR / total_team_games)
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "gray60") +
  geom_point(aes(color = if_else(
    yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
    "Shortened season",
    "Other season"
  ))) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Season type",
    values = c("Other season" = "gray40", "Shortened season" = "firebrick"),
    breaks = c("Other season", "Shortened season")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Home runs per team-game by season",
    subtitle = "Shortened seasons are highlighted",
    x = "MLB season",
    y = "Home runs per team-game",
    caption = "Source: Lahman package"
  )
```

## Season comparison

```{r}
season_comparison <- hr_by_season |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
  arrange(yearID)

knitr::kable(
  season_comparison,
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c(
    "Season",
    "Total home runs",
    "Total team-games",
    "Home runs per game"
  )
)
```
